edits.before: The course takes the finding, not the paper's framing of competence: masking is a practice most of the room runs, at costs that differ by implementation. That is what makes the week 6 ledger a whole-class exercise.

edits.reason: Retain the whole-class relevance without asserting what most people in this particular room do.
